answer_1.quote: In this paper, we adapted MSA transformer for two phonological reconstruction tasks, namely, cognate reflex prediction and proto-language reconstruction.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates reconstructed proto-words or predicted cognate reflexes in phonemic form, such as reconstructing Latin 'pErspIkUIta:.t.E.m' from French and Italian cognates.

answer_2.quote: We use the metrics average edit distance (ED), average normalized edit distance (NED), and B-Cubed F1 score (BC) following ... for evaluating the models.
